points.point: The Vault's 5G device testing value chain lists the chip vendor as one of four ecosystem roles and ties the roles to RF, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance, conformance and carrier-acceptance testing.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention the value-chain roles or chip vendor as one of four roles

points.point: The validation/conformance goals that apply to chipset (semiconductor) work include chipset L1–L4 test plan and verification.
points.label: missing
points.why: no chipset L1-L4 test plan and verification

points.point: Other named chipset-level signaling goals are modem-stack debug and end-to-end IMS/SIP/TCP-IP validation plus app-stack debug.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions IMS/IP/application testing, but not modem-stack debug or explicit SIP/TCP-IP/app-stack debug

points.point: The signaling / protocol / application test layer is mapped to R&S CMX500, CMW500 and CMsquares.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions CMX500 and CMsquares, but not CMW500 or the full layer mapping

points.point: Protocol-conformance signaling capability is used directly with Tier 1 chipset vendors to verify their platforms against WI-555 / RFT 555 NR-NTN test cases.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions NR-NTN PCT/conformance, but not Tier 1 chipset vendors or WI-555/RFT 555 cases

points.point: Chipset vendors are recorded as a source of recent PCT (protocol conformance) demand, notably Rel-17 and RedCap.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not state chipset-vendor PCT demand, Rel-17 demand, or RedCap as especially demanded

points.point: Pre-standard signaling-mode capability on the CMX500 one-box signaling tester was demonstrated with a Broadcom prototype WLAN device before IEEE Wi-Fi 8 ratification.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions Broadcom prototype Wi-Fi 8 signaling tests, but not before IEEE ratification/one-box pre-standard framing

points.point: A virtualized protocol-stack signaling tester is described as a shift-left capability for chipset development, running protocol tests on a virtual terminal before physical chipset manufacture.
points.label: covered
points.why: states virtual terminal pre-silicon shift-left protocol testing before chipset manufacture

invented: Post-silicon basic protocol, functional and regression testing
